item.title: World War II British Submarine Operations in the Pacific
item.description: By Arnold Blumberg During World War II, after the Royal Navy’s traumatic departure from the Pacific Ocean in early 1942, the 4th Submarine Flotilla and its depot ship, the HMS Adamant, operated with the Eastern Fleet based at Trincomalee––a large, natural harbor located on the coast of Sri Lanka in the heart of the Indian Ocean. item.title: Hitler’s Death in the Führerbunker
item.description: By Flint Whitlock His world was literally crashing down in flames around him.
